**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

We are seeking a highly specialized AI & CAD Engineering Applications Expert to lead the design, development, and deployment of AI‑driven automation and intelligence within CAD and engineering workflows. This role sits at the intersection of mechanical/electrical engineering, CAD system customization, and applied AI/ML, and will play a critical role in transforming traditional rule‑based CAD automation into data‑driven, intelligent engineering systems.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands‑on expertise in AI language models, Agentic AI applications, and AI project implementation. The candidate will also possess hands on experience and deep understanding of MCAD systems (NX / Creo) and functions with deep knowledge on generative AI capabilities, strong CAD automation and customization skills, and practical experience applying AI/ML in CAD automation and features, generative AI, or optimization techniques to engineering problems such as design validation, configuration, routing, change management, and knowledge reuse. The candidate may also work on AI CAD adjacent technologies and capabilities such as Digital Twin and Virtual Twin CAD visualization with AI derived data analytics.

* Architect and develop AI‑enabled CAD automation solutions across the engineering lifecycle, 3D geometry creation and analysis (Including algorithms), concept design, detailed modeling, validation, detailing, and change management.
* Apply machine learning, generative AI, and optimization techniques to enhance CAD automation beyond traditional rule‑based scripting.
* Lead AI‑based initiatives.

* Develop Engineering CAD AI strategies, roadmaps and vision.

* Reduction in engineering cycle time through AI‑enabled CAD automation.
* Increased automation coverage and model quality.
* Adoption of AI‑based tools across product groups.
* Measurable improvements in design consistency, product quality, product development lead-time, and design compliance.

**Who we’re looking for**
-------------------------

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline.
* 8+ years of hands‑on experience with CAD systems and engineering applications, with 4+ years in CAD automation/customization.
* Deep and demonstrated experience applying AI/ML, optimization, or generative techniques to engineering or CAD‑adjacent problems.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in NX and/or Creo (modeling, assemblies, drawings).
* Proficiency with NX Open / Creo APIs, C#, C++, and/or Python.
* Solid foundation in geometry, numerical methods, and engineering physics.
* Experience with AI/ML concepts, including supervised learning, rule extraction, optimization, or generative models.

jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla's Vehicle Engineering department is composed of thousands of the world's best vehicle, battery, and manufacturing engineers. These engineers are responsible for the mechanical and industrial design of all major programs, for example, batteries, Optimus, Robotaxi, and all new factories. Design Technology, which is part of Vehicle Engineering, is responsible for making the tools these engineers use every bit as intelligent and dynamic as the products themselves.

As a PLM Quality & Support Engineer on the Design Technology team, you will own the accuracy of the Engineering BOM in and outside our PLM systems. Teams across Tesla depend on that data every day, from the design engineers creating our next products to the factory line itself. When something looks wrong, you decide whether it's a system defect or user error, find the root cause, and make sure it doesn't happen again.

Joining our team means directly impacting Tesla's ability to communicate critical design data as the company scales to ship millions of products a year from factories around the world.

 **What You'll Do**

* Validate EBOM and file data against the design intent in our PLM systems of record. Catch errors before they reach suppliers and factory lines
* Run migration and release checks, and validate changes to customer-facing data before they ship
* Triage defects end to end. Tell system issues from user error, find the root cause, and hand engineering a defect report they can act on
* Be first-line support for engineers, buyers, and supplier-facing teams on access, missing files, and BOM mismatches
* Teach software engineers the PLM concepts behind the data: part revisions, primary and replica objects, maturity states, change actions, and configuration
* Automate the checks you run more than twice, with scripts and coding agents, so validation scales with release volume
* Write everything down so the work is visible: runbooks, known issues, and the reasoning behind each fix

* Hands-on experience with a PLM system (3DEXPERIENCE/Enovia, Teamcenter, Windchill, or equivalent) in an engineering or manufacturing setting
* Deep understanding of EBOM structure, part and drawing revisions, and engineering change processes
* A track record of root-causing data problems across multiple systems, not just reporting them
* SQL and at least one scripting language (Python preferred) to query data and automate checks
* Comfort reading API responses (REST or gRPC) and logs to see where data went wrong
* Clear written communication with both software engineers and non-technical users

jobs.title: Principal Analog/Mixed Signal CAD Engineer - EMIR
jobs.description:
**About Marvell**

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

**Your Team, Your Impact**

We are seeking a Principal Analog/Mixed-Signal CAD Engineer to join our Central Engineering organization in Santa Clara, CA or Irvine, CA. In this role, you will help shape the next generation of design automation infrastructure that supports cutting-edge analog, mixed-signal, and silicon photonics IC development across the company.  
  
This is a highly visible technical leadership role where your work will directly impact how Marvell's global design teams build industry-leading semiconductor products.  
  
You will join Marvell's Central Engineering CAD team, a group responsible for building and supporting the advanced design infrastructure used by hundreds of engineers developing some of the industry's most sophisticated silicon. The team works at the intersection of EDA tools, semiconductor process technology, and circuit design, partnering closely with:  

* Analog and mixed-signal IC design teams
* Silicon photonics engineers
* Foundry partners
* EDA vendors
* Device modeling and TCAD specialists

  
This collaborative environment gives you a unique opportunity to influence the design methodology and automation frameworks used across the entire company.  
  
Technical Focus:  
This position focuses on electromigration and IR-drop (EMIR) analysis for advanced FinFET, BiCMOS, SiGe, and SiPho technologies.

**What You Can Expect**

As a Principal Analog/Mixed-Signal CAD Engineer, you will play a critical role in developing and evolving the automated design flows that enable Marvell's most advanced silicon programs. Key responsibilities include:

* Develop and support electromigration and IR-drop (EMIR) analysis flows, including flow setup, DSPF validation, current-density and voltage-drop analysis, debugging, and post-layout verification.
* Architect and support next-generation automated AMS design flows used across Marvell design teams.
* Build and maintain custom tools, PCells, Pycells, GUI utilities, and automation/productivity tools using scripting languages within the Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys OptoCompiler, and Siemens Calibre environments.
* Install, validate, and support foundry PDKs.
* Set up and maintain physical verification flows, parasitic extraction and EMIR flows.
* Partner with analog designers and EDA vendors to troubleshoot and resolve complex design flow challenges.
* Help shape company-wide CAD infrastructure and best practices for analog, mixed-signal, and silicon photonics development.

Joining Marvell means working on technology that defines the future of computing and connectivity. In this role, you can expect:

* Cutting-edge semiconductor technology: Work on advanced FinFET, BiCMOS, SiGe, and SiPho nodes and next-generation mixed-signal architectures.
* High technical impact: Your methodologies will be used across multiple product lines and engineering teams worldwide.
* Deep collaboration: Partner with world-class designers, modeling experts, and EDA innovators.
* Leadership without limits: Influence CAD strategy and engineering infrastructure across a global semiconductor organization.
* A culture of innovation: Marvell engineers push the boundaries of performance, efficiency, and integration.

You'll also enjoy the energy of working in Silicon Valley's semiconductor innovation hub in Santa Clara alongside engineers building the next generation of AI, networking, and cloud infrastructure silicon.

Please note: This role is based in our Santa Clara or Irvine office and requires onsite presence five days per week. Remote or hybrid work is not available for this position.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong hands-on experience with Cadence Voltus-XFi
* BSEE with 10–15 years of professional experience, or MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering with 5–10 years of industry experience.
* Proven experience building and maintaining analog/mixed-signal design flows for advanced FinFET, BiCMOS, SiGe, and SiPho technologies.
* Strong hands-on experience with industry-standard AMS design tools, including Cadence Virtuoso Studio, Synopsys OptoCompiler, and Siemens Calibre.
* Solid understanding of analog/mixed-signal design flows, including schematic capture, simulation, parasitic extraction, post-layout verification, and EMIR.
* Programming or scripting experience in Python, TCL, Shell, and SKILL.
* Experience developing custom CAD automation or verification frameworks.
* Familiarity with silicon photonics design flows.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with electromagnetic (EM) simulation and extraction.

**Expected Base Pay Range (USD)**

150,680 - 225,700, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

**Additional Compensation and Benefit Elements**

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments.

jobs.description:
**Location:** Mountain View, CA

**About Rune:**

Every solar and wind power plant is a latent data center. Rune connects wasted power to the compute that needs it. Solar plants generate electricity the grid can't take: clipped by inverters, curtailed by operators, gone before it ever reaches a meter. Meanwhile, AI needs more power than new construction can deliver in time.

Rune deploys hardware, software, and financial solutions to put this power to work. We build modular micro data centers that install directly at solar sites, bypassing the traditional grid entirely and turning stranded power into compute. We're backed by Spark Capital, Union Square Ventures, and Lowercarbon Capital.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Quality Control Technician to support product quality throughout the manufacturing and receiving processes. This role will be responsible for performing final inspection and testing, verifying the accuracy and completeness of product travelers and manufacturing documentation, conducting incoming and receiving inspections, and supporting inventory audits.

You’ll be the last line of defense on product quality, covering inspection and testing, documentation checks, and receiving. You’ll also own the reporting that shows how quality is trending. This is a growth role: the right person can move into Quality Engineering as we scale.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Final Inspection and Product Testing**

* Perform functional, dimensional, and visual inspections against specs, drawings, and acceptance criteria, and document the results
* Verify finished products meet requirements before release or shipment
* Keep measuring and test equipment calibrated and in good working condition

**2. Product Travelers and Manufacturing Documentation**

* Review travelers, work orders, and inspection records for completeness, accuracy, and proper sign-off sequence
* Resolve missing information or process deviations with the responsible teams before product release
* Keep quality records organized and easy to retrieve

**3. Incoming and Receiving Inspection**

* Inspect incoming materials and parts against POs, drawings, specs, and certifications (part numbers, revisions, quantities)
* Report discrepancies and damaged or nonconforming material, and work with Purchasing and the Warehouse on disposition
* Track recurring supplier issues and trends

**4. Inventory Audits and Traceability**

* Run periodic audits to verify part identification, quantities, condition, and lot/serial traceability
* Reconcile physical inventory to system records and investigate discrepancies
* Flag expired, damaged, or improperly identified material for resolution

**5. Quality Reporting, Excel, and KPI Tracking**

* Build and maintain Excel reports and dashboards covering pass/fail rates, nonconformance trends, incoming quality, and documentation completion
* Deliver routine status reports on inspections, open quality issues, and product readiness
* Analyze data to spot recurring issues and communicate findings to management

**6. Nonconformance and Continuous Improvement**

* Identify, document, and segregate nonconforming product, and support investigations, root cause analysis, and CAPA
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain to resolve quality concerns
* Help improve inspection procedures, checklists, and work instructions

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; technical training, an associate degree, or relevant coursework in quality, manufacturing, engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous experience in quality control, manufacturing inspection, receiving inspection, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel including the ability to organize, analyze, and present data and generate status reports and KPI summaries.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies in products, processes, and documentation.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, work instructions, and inspection criteria.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple inspection and documentation priorities.
* Ability to work collaboratively across Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with dimensional inspection tools, measurement equipment, and functional test equipment.
* Familiarity with manufacturing documentation, product travelers, inspection plans, and product traceability.
* Experience with ERP, inventory management, or quality management systems.
* Familiarity with quality management standards such as ISO 9001 or other applicable industry standards.
* Exposure to nonconformance reporting, root cause analysis, corrective actions, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, lookup functions, charts, conditional formatting, and data visualization.
* Familiarity with statistical process control (SPC), failure analysis, or other quality engineering tools.

**Success in this role will be measured by:**  
Excelling in inspection, documentation, receiving, and reporting. As you prove out, take on root cause analysis, process improvement, and quality systems you can work on the path to Quality Engineer. This position is intended for someone who wants to build a long-term career in quality. We are looking for someone who can perform today's quality control responsibilities reliably while demonstrating the curiosity, analytical thinking, and initiative to help improve our quality processes for the future.
